# Vuetify integration — Cogniterm Design System

> This system lives ALONGSIDE Vuetify 3.11, it does not replace it.
> No migration. Existing screens are unchanged. Vuetify stays at 3.11 — v4 is not planned.
> Docs: https://kimjiyong995-coder.github.io/design-system/#/docs/vuetify

## Setup
```ts
import { createVuetify } from 'vuetify'
import { dsTheme } from '~/design/theme'       // colors — applies to ALL Vuetify components
import { dsDefaults } from '~/design/defaults' // per-component defaults (77 components)

createVuetify({ theme: dsTheme, defaults: dsDefaults, icons: lucideIconSet })
// icons is REQUIRED: import { lucideIconSet } from '~/design/vuetify-icons'.
// It maps every internal Vuetify alias (checkbox glyphs, select chevrons, sort
// arrows, alert icons...) to Lucide. Without it they render as blank glyphs,
// since the default is the uninstalled @mdi webfont. String icons resolve via
// the semantic registry: <v-icon icon="agent" />.
```
Load `ds.css` and `ds-vuetify.css`. Install `pretendard` and `lucide-vue-next`.
Omitting the Pretendard CSS silently falls back to the system font with no error.

## Why some components need Vuetify and others don't
Behavior that is hard to rebuild correctly (focus trap, viewport-aware positioning,
scroll lock, keyboard navigation, sorting, pagination, IME-safe filtering) stays
Vuetify. Purely visual components and agent-specific ones are built from scratch.
"Standalone" means "does not REQUIRE Vuetify" — those components still work perfectly
inside a Vuetify app and are unaffected by Vuetify version changes.

## Isolation guarantees (verified in CI)
- 0 vuetify imports in standalone components
- 0 !important in ds.css
- 0 .v-* class definitions in ds.css
- all:unset on every component root

## Coverage — all 98 Vuetify components are styled
### Wrapped as Ds* (5) — import from ~/design/vuetify
- VDataTable -> DsDataTable (정렬·페이지네이션·선택)
- VDialog -> DsDialog (포커스 트랩·스크롤 락)
- VMenu -> DsMenu (포지셔닝·키보드 네비)
- VTooltip -> DsTooltip (지연 표시·터치 대응)
- VSelect -> DsSelect (옵션 포지셔닝·다중 선택)

### Styled by theme + defaults (69) — use plain <v-*>, no setup needed
VBtn, VBtnGroup, VBtnToggle, VFab, VSpeedDial, VCard, VSheet, VToolbar, VAppBar, VFooter, VSystemBar, VExpansionPanel, VParallax, VNavigationDrawer, VBottomNavigation, VTabs, VBreadcrumbs, VPagination, VStepper, VTextField, VTextarea, VAutocomplete, VCombobox, VFileInput, VNumberInput, VOtpInput, VCheckbox, VRadio, VRadioGroup, VSwitch, VSlider, VRangeSlider, VRating, VDatePicker, VTimePicker, VColorPicker, VCalendar, VConfirmEdit, VForm, VAlert, VBanner, VChip, VBadge, VProgressLinear, VProgressCircular, VSkeletonLoader, VSnackbar, VSnackbarQueue, VEmptyState, VOverlay, VBottomSheet, VTable, VDataTableServer, VDataTableVirtual, VDataIterator, VList, VTreeview, VVirtualScroll, VInfiniteScroll, VTimeline, VSparkline, VAvatar, VIcon, VImg, VCarousel, VWindow, VSlideGroup, VDivider, VLazy

### Styled by CSS only (13) — internal primitives
VField, VInput, VLabel, VMessages, VCounter, VSelectionControl, VSelectionControlGroup, VChipGroup, VItemGroup, VCode, VKbd, VHotkey, VOverflowBtn

### No visual surface (11)
VApp, VMain, VLayout, VGrid, VResponsive, VHover, VNoSsr, VValidation, VDefaultsProvider, VThemeProvider, VLocaleProvider
